description: Cambridge fNIRS dataset containing functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) neuroimaging data. This is a raw fNIRS dataset mirrored from OpenNeuro (ds007714). This dataset is a mirror/copy of the original OpenNeuro dataset. For detailed information about participants, experimental design, data collection methods, study protocols, authors, and funding, please refer to the original dataset on OpenNeuro at https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds007714 and its associated documentation.
